shared_elements: upright carved stone monument on museum display
low-relief carving on a flat-fronted stone surface
rectangular framed relief units or panels
justification: Both are vertical stone monuments carved in low relief and photographed in gallery settings, and both include enclosed rectangular relief units and a prominent circular/disc element among curvilinear motifs. However, A is a slender, pale, evenly ruled slab entirely covered by a regular grid of small square glyph-like blocks, while B is a massive dark boulder shaped into a head-and-shoulders form with a few large, weathered, asymmetrically placed emblems on otherwise blank stone.
